import sys
import math

class Reader:
    @staticmethod
    def init(input_stream):
        Reader.stream = input_stream
        Reader.tokens = []

    @staticmethod
    def next():
        while not Reader.tokens:
            line = sys.stdin.readline()
            if not line:
                return None
            Reader.tokens = line.strip().split()
        return Reader.tokens.pop(0)

    @staticmethod
    def nextInt():
        return int(Reader.next())

    @staticmethod
    def nextLong():
        return int(Reader.next())

    @staticmethod
    def nextDouble():
        return float(Reader.next())

def main():
    Reader.init(sys.stdin)
    n = Reader.nextInt()
    b = Reader.nextInt()

    arr = [0] * (n + 1)
    oddcount = [0] * (n + 1)
    evencount = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        arr[i] = Reader.nextInt()
        if arr[i] % 2 == 1:
            oddcount[i] = oddcount[i - 1] + 1
            evencount[i] = evencount[i - 1]
        else:
            oddcount[i] = oddcount[i - 1]
            evencount[i] = evencount[i - 1] + 1

    cut = 0
    arr2 = [0] * ((n // 2) - 1)
    for i in range(2, n, 2):
        if oddcount[i] == evencount[i]:
            arr2[i // 2 - 1] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1])
        else:
            arr2[i // 2 - 1] = -1

    arr2.sort()
    total_sum = 0
    for value in arr2:
        if value != -1 and total_sum + value <= b:
            cut += 1
            total_sum += value

    print(cut)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
